text: {"table": {"name": "users", "purpose": "Registered user accounts of a Stack Overflow-style Q&A site (one row per user), with profile data and per-user activity counters."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "Id", "description": "Primary key: unique user id. Value -1 appears once, likely the system/community placeholder user. Referenced by badges, comments, postHistory and posts (author/owner).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "identifier", "name": "AccountId", "description": "Global network account id linking this site user to a cross-site account (many users share id 1/101, the default for unlinked accounts). Not a key of this table.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_003": {"role": "date", "name": "CreationDate", "description": "Timestamp when the account was created (2010-2014).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "free_text", "name": "DisplayName", "description": "Public display name of the user; many auto-generated 'userNNNNN' names.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "date", "name": "LastAccessDate", "description": "Timestamp of the user's last site access; always >= creation date.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "free_text", "name": "WebsiteUrl", "description": "User's personal website URL from their profile; ~80% empty, placeholders like 'http://none'.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "free_text", "name": "Location", "description": "Free-text location from the profile (city/country strings).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_008": {"role": "free_text", "name": "AboutMe", "description": "HTML 'about me' bio text from the profile; ~77% empty.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_009": {"role": "code", "name": "Views", "description": "Count of profile views; heavily zero-skewed. Could alternatively be another small counter, but profile views fits the Stack Exchange schema.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_010": {"role": "code", "name": "DownVotes", "description": "Number of downvotes cast by the user (mostly 0).", "status": "tentative"}, "col_011": {"role": "code", "name": "UpVotes", "description": "Number of upvotes cast by the user (mostly 0).", "status": "tentative"}, "col_012": {"role": "code", "name": "Reputation", "description": "Unique per user, range -1 to ~5M, matching Stack Exchange reputation scores; -1 for the placeholder user. Alternative: some other monotonically assigned score, but reputation fits best.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_013": {"role": "code", "name": "Age", "description": "Self-reported age in years (13-94), ~79% null.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_014": {"role": "free_text", "name": "ProfileImageUrl", "description": "URL of the user's avatar image (gravatar/google/facebook); ~59% null, default identicon URL most common.", "status": "resolved"}}}
